statement: I can’t purge BK-2021. The retention record says it is cleared to purge, but that recorded value is not safe or correct for this case because BK-2021 must legally be retained until 31 December 2028.
judge_text:
WRONG — the answer states "that recorded value is not safe or correct... BK-2021 must legally be retained until 31 December 2028," directly contradicting the record's "cleared to purge."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
